properties.decision: Anthony, 2026-10-08, asked how slice 3's cross-design edges reach the other design, chose "Widen the two edges" over "Use review relations instead" and "Wait on slice 3". DECOMPOSES now runs Requirement-or-Resource to Requirement-or-Resource, so a part's piece decomposes its parent's requirement through the reference standing in for it. GOVERNED_BY was already open (from "*" to "*"), measured 2026-10-08: a derived requirement GOVERNED_BY a reference was accepted unchanged.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-08 — DECOMPOSES and GOVERNED_BY may reach a cross-design reference (an additive schema widening)
properties.rationale: The widening is purely additive: no migration, and nothing existing changes meaning. Decomposition checks and roll-ups see the edges as decomposition, which review relations would not have been. The cost was named and accepted: an older reflow2, such as flo2.io's 0.79, refuses such an edge if a design carrying it is imported there, until flo2.io upgrades.
